blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: An interrupt signals an event such as device completion to the processor.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: The CPU saves sufficient execution context before servicing the event.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: An ISR handles the interrupt, acknowledges it, then restores normal execution state.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: The ISR processes keyboard input before restoring the prior program state.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: The ISR can acknowledge completion and allow queued device work to proceed; the interrupted task resumes.
